verses.text: Simon Peter, servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those wey don receive faith wey dey as precious as our own, through di righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ.
Make grace and peace plenty for una through di knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
Im divine power don give us everything wey we need for life and for godliness, through di knowledge of am wey call us by im own glory and goodness.

Through dis glory and goodness, e don give us im very great and precious promises, so that through dem una go share for di divine nature, as una don escape di corruption wey dey di world through evil desire.
Yes, and for dis same reason, make una try well well to add goodness to your faith, and knowledge to your goodness;
and self-control to your knowledge, and patience to your self-control, and godliness to your patience;
and brotherly kindness to your godliness, and love to your brotherly kindness.
For if dis things dey una and dey grow, dem go make una no dey idle or without fruit for di knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For anybody wey no get dis things dey blind, e no dey see far, and e don forget say dem don clean am from im old sins.
So, my brothers, make una try pass before to make your calling and your choosing sure. If una do dis things, una no go ever fall;
for na so dem go give una full welcome enter di Kingdom wey no dey end of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
So I go always dey ready to remind una about dis things, even though una know am and don stand strong for di truth wey una get now.
I think say e right, as long as I dey inside dis tent, to wake una up by reminding una;
because I know say soon I go put down dis tent of mine, just as our Lord Jesus Christ show me.
Yes, I go try make una fit remember dis things at any time after I don go.
For we no follow stories wey people cleverly invent when we make di power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ known to una, but we don be eyewitnesses of im majesty.
For e receive honour and glory from Papa God, when di voice come to am from di Majestic Glory talk say, “Dis na my Pikin wey I love, wey I dey happy with.”
We hear dis voice wey come from heaven when we dey with am for di holy mountain.
We also get di word of di prophets wey dey more sure; una dey do well to pay attention to am, as to lamp wey dey shine for dark place, until day break and di morning star rise for your hearts.
First of all, know dis: no prophecy of Scripture dey come from anybody own interpretation.
For prophecy no ever come by di will of man, but holy men of God talk as Holy Spirit move dem.

But false prophets also dey among di people, just as false teachers go dey among una. Dem go secretly bring in wrong teaching wey go destroy, even deny di Lord wey buy dem, and bring quick destruction on dem own head.
Plenty people go follow dem for dem shameful ways, and because of dem, people go speak evil of di way of truth.
For dem greed, dem go use made-up words trade una. Dem judgment wey don dey from long time no dey sleep, and dem destruction no dey slumber.
For if God no spare angels wey sin, but throw dem enter Tartarus and put dem inside chains of darkness to dey kept for judgment;
and e no spare di ancient world, but e keep Noah, di eighth person, wey preach righteousness, when e bring flood on di world of di ungodly;
and e turn di cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ash, condemn dem with destruction, and make dem example to those wey go live ungodly;
and e rescue righteous Lot, wey dey suffer because of di sinful behaviour of lawless people,
for dat righteous man, as e dey live among dem, day by day im righteous soul dey torment because of di lawless deeds wey e see and hear.
Di Lord know how to rescue di godly from temptation, and how to keep di unrighteous under punishment for di day of judgment;
but mostly dem wey follow di flesh for di lust of defilement, and wey despise authority. Dem dey bold and dey do wetin dem like, dem no fear to speak evil of glorious ones;
whereas angels, wey get more strength and power, no dey bring accusation against dem before di Lord.
But dis people, like animals wey no get sense, wey dem born to catch and destroy, dey speak evil of things wey dem no know, and dem go perish inside dem own destruction,
dey suffer wrong as pay for di wrong wey dem do. Dem count am pleasure to enjoy themselves for daytime. Dem na spots and blemishes, dey enjoy dem deceit while dem dey feast with una;
dem eyes full of adultery wey no dey stop sin; dem dey lure unstable souls; dem heart don learn greed; dem na cursed pikin dem;
dem don leave di right way and go astray, dey follow di way of Balaam, Beor pikin, wey love di pay for wrongdoing;
but e get rebuke for im own wrong: donkey wey no fit talk speak with man voice and stop di prophet madness.
Dis people na fountains wey no get water, and mists wey storm dey drive; di blackest darkness don dey kept for dem forever.
For dem dey talk big big empty words, and dey use fleshly desires and shameless ways to catch people wey just escape from those wey dey live in error;
dem dey promise dem freedom, while dem own selves na slaves of corruption; for anything wey overcome person, na di person don become im slave.

For if, after dem don escape di defilements of di world through di knowledge of di Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, dem enter am again and e overcome dem, di last state don become worse for dem pass di first.
For e for better for dem if dem no know di way of righteousness, than to know am and den turn back from di holy commandment wey dem receive.
But wetin di true proverb talk don happen to dem: “Di dog don return to im own vomit,” and “di sow wey don wash don go roll for di mud.”
Dis na now di second letter wey I dey write una, beloved. For both of dem I dey wake up your sincere mind by reminding una;
make una remember di words wey di holy prophets don talk before, and di commandment of us, di apostles of di Lord and Saviour;
first of all, know dis: for di last days, mockers go come, dey mock and dey follow dem own evil desires,
and dey talk say, “Wia di promise of im coming dey? For since di papa dem die, everything dey continue as e dey from di beginning of creation.”
For dem choose to forget dis: by God word, heavens dey long ago, and di earth form out of water and through water,
and through dem di world wey dey dat time perish, as water cover am.
But di heavens wey dey now and di earth, by di same word, dem dey keep dem for fire, dey kept for di day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
But no make dis one thing hide from una, beloved: with di Lord, one day na like 1,000 years, and 1,000 years na like one day.
Di Lord no dey slow about im promise, as some people count slowness, but e dey patient with una, e no wan make anybody perish, but make everybody come to repentance.
But di day of di Lord go come like thief. For dat day, di heavens go pass away with big noise, and di elements go melt with great heat, and di earth and di works wey dey inside am go burn up.
Since everything go dissolve like dis, wetin kind of people una suppose be, for holy living and godliness,
as una dey wait and dey hurry di coming of di day of God, wey because of am di heavens go dissolve as fire burn dem, and di elements go melt with great heat?
But according to im promise, we dey wait for new heavens and new earth, wia righteousness dey live.
So, beloved, since una dey wait for dis things, try well well make e find una without spot and without blame, for peace.
Count di patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also write to una according to di wisdom wey God give am;

as e also talk for all im letters, as e dey speak for dem about dis things. Inside dem, some things dey hard to understand, wey people wey no get knowledge and wey no dey stand firm dey twist, as dem also do di other Scriptures, to dem own destruction.
You, beloved, since you don know dis things before, take care, make di error of lawless people no carry una go, and make una no fall from your own firm ground.
But grow for grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To am dey glory both now and to di day wey no dey end. Amen.
